goal: Explainable company valuation from preserved evidence, with inspectable decisions and a simple local interface.
scope: Personal use; ordinary operating companies first. Review saved analyses before adding analysis launch and refresh controls. Agents update this plan during working sessions; the user reviews and merges PRs.

milestones.title: Evidence and valuation foundation
milestones.summary: Deterministic acquisition, preserved evidence, named formulas and a company-neutral core with a worked example.

milestones.title: Persistent project workflow
milestones.summary: Short README, project instructions, current plan, clear boundaries, PR rules and local progress display.

milestones.title: Validate financial inputs across companies
milestones.summary: Harden storage and verify material definitions and selected inputs beyond the first issuer.

milestones.title: Inspect saved valuations
milestones.summary: Connect source evidence and decision rationale to a read-only analysis viewer.

milestones.title: Frozen multi-company development corpus
milestones.summary: Clarify retained-use permissions and preserve a representative dated corpus for offline development.

tasks.title: Preserve deterministic API acquisition
acceptance: Explicit company inputs; raw responses, hashes and safe diagnostics are preserved.
tasks.note: Existing implementation. General report discovery/OCR remains outside this completed task.

tasks.title: Store and freeze source-linked evidence
acceptance: SQLite observations and source files preserve identity and revisions; frozen bundles are verified.
tasks.note: Existing stores passed read-only integrity, foreign-key and source-hash checks on 3 November. Wider operational claims remain bounded by the readiness review.

tasks.title: Define valuation policy and named calculations
acceptance: Policy and formula definitions are frozen into new packets and deterministic outputs retain input references.
tasks.note: Forward operating EV/EBIT is the primary model. This task does not establish predictive accuracy or complete accounting mappings.

tasks.title: Keep shared workflow generic and issuer work in examples
acceptance: Shared commands take explicit company inputs; worked-example assumptions are separate.
tasks.note: Main restructure is merged. A second real-company walkthrough remains a separate validation task.

tasks.title: Make project state and working rules persistent
acceptance: README provides a short directory map and clear entry points.
Project instructions define plan updates, boundaries and user-reviewed PRs.
Local read-only dashboard displays the current plan and handles reload failures safely.
Relevant tests, browser verification and independent review are recorded.
Publish the focused change as a PR for user review, after the user settles the public-document scope.

Browser verified filtering, criteria navigation, stale-state warning and recovery. Working-tree suite: 95 passed, one pre-existing missing example-manifest error; unrelated rename preserved. JavaScript syntax, documentation links and whitespace checks pass. User approved publishing all 16 files. PR #2 is open for user review/merge: https://github.com/KapKnudz/betaforge-reborn/pull/2. tasks.title: Harden schema compatibility and expose freshness
acceptance: Unsupported existing schema versions are rejected before any schema/version write.
Queries distinguish financial period, source publication, first capture and last successful check.
Focused compatibility and unchanged-refresh tests pass.
Shared metadata units remain correct when older captures are imported after newer ones directly through EvidenceStore.
tasks.note: Current version-1 stores are healthy. The corpus builder now sorts captures; arbitrary standalone store ingestion still needs the shared-metadata chronology regression alongside schema/freshness hardening.

tasks.title: Record financial meaning and selected-input rationale
acceptance: Material inputs retain definition status separately from numeric reconciliation.
Scope, units, period, conventions, residuals, evidence and selection reasons are inspectable.
Report substitutions and assumptions keep optional gaps local.
tasks.note: Reuse the existing mapping specification; do not build a second mapping platform.

tasks.title: Verify another issuer, then three to five different operating businesses
acceptance: Another real-company end-to-end walkthrough succeeds with source-linked material inputs.
Selected businesses exercise different capital intensity, acquisitions, leases or share-count conventions.
Archived report coverage is distinguished from mandatory analyst reading.
tasks.note: General report discovery/preparation still needs a minimal reusable path; five annuals remain the reading baseline where available.

tasks.title: Expose saved evidence, decisions and valuation bridges
acceptance: Material forecasts, multiples, probabilities and cash/claims assumptions have evidence and rationale.
A read-only local viewer links financial history, source comparisons, named calculations and scenario results.
Opening saved results makes no provider or model calls.
tasks.note: Reuse frozen packets and run artifacts. The project progress dashboard does not satisfy this task.

tasks.title: Clarify frozen-data use before relying on cancellation
acceptance: Applicable permissions for post-subscription personal reuse, local display, private backup and AI processing are established.
tasks.note: User confirmed on 3 November 2026 that permission is resolved and instructed capture to proceed. This prerequisite is settled for the project.

tasks.title: Freeze the verified Börsdata API development corpus
acceptance: Capture ten distinct issuers with agreed API dataset families, definitions, actual history coverage and hashes.
Preserve exact API evidence separately from public code and verify a clean restore.
Record frozen cutoffs, empty optional datasets and unreviewed mappings; keep original PDF coverage and later live checks separate.
tasks.note: Completed the API-only corpus for ten distinct issuers: 970/970 responses, 880 source blobs and 264,214 current observations. Raw coverage/identity/basis/hash checks, SQLite integrity/foreign keys, clean archive restore and a downloaded remote-copy checksum pass. A metadata-format audit checked 22,335 percentage/MCURR observations with zero mismatches. Exact data and receipts are in the private release development-corpus-2026-11-03. Final clean suite: 103 tests, OK with one skipped private-evidence class. Greptile identified argument-order-dependent units; the verifier now ingests chronologically with reversed-order regression coverage. Original PDFs and accounting reconciliation remain separate pending tasks. PR #3 contains generic tooling/docs only and awaits final current-head review and user merge.

tasks.title: Complete original-report coverage for the development companies
acceptance: Preserve the five latest available annual reports and five years of interims for the selected corpus, with coverage gaps explicit.
Keep originals, readable physical-page text, source URLs and hashes together.
Select mandatory analyst reading separately from the full archive.
tasks.note: API capture does not include original PDFs. Existing worked-example reports are preserved separately; remaining issuer reports can be acquired without live Börsdata access.

session.summary: Ten-company paid API data is frozen, checked, privately archived and verified after clean restore and remote download. Permission is settled. Code/plan changes are in PR #3; user merge remains pending.
